title: Chapter 332 Wu Qing Breaks The World
content:
Chapter 332 Wu Qing Breaks The World

"So that's it!"

Although Wu Qing was a little surprised that the weird lord of the Endless Mountains would tell him about his weird origins, he didn't say much.

Wu Qing didn't want to speculate for the time being about the purpose of the weird lord of the Endless Mountains. As long as his own strength is sufficient and he develops according to the predetermined plan, all the problems in this world will not be a problem.

"Your child once used the creatures of the underground world to attack me. What's the matter with the underground world?"

Wu Qing thought of the strange connection between the underground world and the weird, so he asked another question.

"The underground world is also a mezzanine world of this world. There are many descendants of this world living in it. After so many years of closed development, it is very different from the outside world."

"There are many mezzanine worlds in this world, but the area of general mezzanine worlds is not large. Many powerful races have their own mezzanine worlds."

"There are many mezzanine worlds in my Endless Mountains. Many of the races in your native camp who actively avoid the world have gone to the mezzanine world of my Endless Mountains."

"There are several native races in the underground world that are very powerful. If you are interested, you can try to communicate with them."

The weird lord of the Endless Mountains patiently explained the things about the mezzanine world to Wu Qing.

"Thank you for clearing up my doubts! I'll give this naughty child back to you!"

Wu Qing didn't ask any more questions. He put away the power of the domain and released the weirdness.

A powerful force instantly took back the weirdness that Wu Qing released.

"Lord, welcome to visit my Endless Mountains when you are free!"

The strange lord of the Endless Mountains said a polite word to Wu Qing, then quietly retreated without any movement.

Wu Qing smiled and entered the nine-star Protoss transport spaceship.

Wu Qing used the power of the Zerg clan to open up the space between the real world and the strange mezzanine world. The nine-star Protoss transport spaceship, carrying Wu Qing and a powerful combat force, entered the mysterious strange mezzanine world.

…

Everything seemed to be covered with a gray veil. The strange mezzanine world gave Wu Qing the feeling that it was like the real world at night, but it looked more desolate and lifeless.

With Wu Qing's powerful spiritual perception, he could clearly perceive that this mezzanine world had an aura that did not belong to this world, and the will of the world rules could not extend here.

The will of the world rules has been driving the native races to attack the strange mezzanine world. It should be to expel this force that does not belong to this world.

This force is the same as the foreign unknown force mentioned by the powerful weird lord of the Endless Mountains, and it is also the source of the birth of weirdness in this world.

The small fights mentioned by the weird lord of the Endless Mountains are about the major tribes in the local camps who are only eliminating weirdness to complete the tasks set by the world rules. This level of attack is not as fast as the birth of weirdness in the weird interlayer world.

Therefore, over the years, the power of the weird interlayer world has not weakened at all.

Wu Qing felt it carefully and could also sense that if only a part of the weirdness in the weird interlayer world was eliminated, the unknown force released would generate new weirdness in the weird interlayer world.

This cycle repeats itself, and the weird power that invaded this world has not weakened at all.

But after the advent of the system, this situation has changed a lot. With the characteristics of the system, if you kill the weirdness, you must peel off a layer of skin. No matter what weird and unknown mysterious power it is, it will not work here in the system, and it must become a system resource obediently.

In other words, the strangeness that the Zerg and Protoss destroyed was destroyed because of the existence of the system, and the terrible power that the world could not do anything about was also destroyed.

This may be one of the reasons why the rules and will of this world give special treatment to the Zerg. The arrival of the Zerg has given the world real hope of returning to normal.

But the rules and will of this world are still too simple. Taking advantage of the system will eventually suffer a big loss.

The nine-star Protoss transport spacecraft flew quickly in the strange interlayer world to collect intelligence.

Wu Qing also discovered many bases established by various large and super large clans in the local camp. These races have been fighting in the strange interlayer world for a long time to maintain the status of the race.

Ordinary armies can't hold on in such a strange world, so the weakest armies of various races in the strange interlayer world are all five-star arms.

A large number of seven-star and above strong men of various races have been fighting in the strange interlayer world all year round, and many powerful strong men of various races are in this world.

In the strange mezzanine world that is beyond the jurisdiction of the world rules, ten-star powerful people can act at will, but there are also many powerful people on the strange side, and even eleven-star super strong people like the strange lord of the Endless Mountains are hidden.

In this strange mezzanine world, if you are not careful, the entire core force of a large clan may be destroyed in an instant.

The strange mezzanine world is a very dangerous world. Every race acts cautiously in this world.

Now Wu Qing has come in person. He has walked a lot of places and kept sensing. He feels more and more that the unknown mysterious power has a familiar taste.

"In this strange world, I feel your presence again!"

In the world where Wu Qing originally lived, there was also a force behind the scenes, which had been controlling the beast tide to target the human race, and was finally forcibly expelled by Wu Qing.

Now that world has become a system-affiliated world and has become a safe world.

Unexpectedly, after coming to this world and going around in circles, Wu Qing felt the existence of that power in the dark again.

"If that's the case, then I won't be polite!"

Wu Qing has discovered many strange gathering areas, and in the strange gathering areas, the foreign power is particularly obvious.

Wu Qing, who has not personally taken action for a long time, with his ten-star great power level, is equivalent to the super combat power of an eleven-star super power. In this strange interlayer world where the rules of this world cannot control, he took action as much as he could.

Wu Qing's mind moved, and the infinite energy of heaven and earth was mobilized, instantly creating an energy violent zone in the strange gathering place below. The powerful energy of the interlayer world could not heal the wounds left by this attack.

This was done intentionally by Wu Qing. This strange interlayer world was almost integrated with the external force. Attacking this strange interlayer world was to attack the external strange force.

The violent energy of heaven and earth was raging, and the space cracks appeared from time to time. The area attacked by Wu Qing was like a wound left on this strange interlayer world.

After one attack, Wu Qing felt refreshed and in a very good mood.

The nine-star Protoss transport spacecraft flew all the way. Wu Qing kept attacking the strange gathering place of the strange interlayer world with the power of the evil god, causing trauma to this strange interlayer world.

The movement caused by Wu Qing made the bases of various tribes in the local camp dare not make any more moves. Some of the bases of the large tribes without the protection of the powerful took the initiative to withdraw their troops and strong men for fear of being affected.

Those powerful figures in charge of various tribes were also shocked by Wu Qing's powerful strength and tough means.

Wu Qing dared to do this, but other powerful people did not dare to do so, because this strange mezzanine world is a strange world, and the truly powerful is still strange.

Wu Qing's unscrupulous attack finally attracted the intervention of the powerful weird.

The sky and the earth changed color, and energy gathered.

Various powerful attacks that far exceeded ordinary attacks and helped the heaven and earth attacked in the direction of Wu Qing.

Wu Qing has many powerful killing methods, but he does not use them. He began to compete with the powerful weird for the control of the energy of heaven and earth, and used the energy of heaven and earth to create various attacks with great noises to counterattack the powerful weird.

Huanyuan app! .huanyuanapp

"Boom...!"

The collision of the powerful forces caused the sky to collapse and the earth to crack, and life was extinct!

More ordinary native camp clans did not dare to watch the show in the strange mezzanine world anymore, and quickly withdrew to the real world for temporary shelter.

"Which great man is doing this? The fight is so intense? Aren't you afraid of attracting those weird people in the dark to attack?"

"Looking at their behavior, they are a bit like the Zerg who have just gained the status of a great tribe. Their origins are mysterious and their background is extremely profound. Only they dare to make such a big noise as soon as they enter this world!"

"If it is the Zerg, then it is possible! I heard that they have defeated the Snow Demon Tribe in the northern theater, and now the Snow Demon Tribe has tucked its tail between its legs in the northern theater, haha!"

"The latest news is that the Zerg has sent a large number of troops to assist our camp , launching a full-scale counterattack against the evil god camp!"

"Looking at this posture, the Zerg is ready to beat this world to death. If they can destroy this world, it will be a great achievement!"

"Everyone should not watch the show first, and withdraw the forces of each race first to avoid being affected!"

"Okay! Everyone organizes the retreat first, and we will gather again later to see how far the Zerg can fight this time!"

"If necessary, we will also contribute!"

"..."

When the powerful people in the local camp noticed the abnormality, they all gathered together to exchange information and opinions.

To be on the safe side, everyone decided to withdraw all the living forces of each race back to the real world first.

...

Wu Qing did not deliberately attack the attacking powerful weird, but mobilized the energy of heaven and earth to bombard everywhere. Wherever he passed, the weird disappeared.

Other powerful weirds joined in and besieged Wu Qing.

The ten-star powers in this world, although their attack capabilities are very strong due to the incomplete world rules, their own defense capabilities and vitality are still no different from normal ten-star creatures.

It is easy for Wu Qing to kill these powerful weirds. He does not do this because he wants to use the weird power in this weird interlayer world to destroy this world together.

Wu Qing mobilized more power of heaven and earth to put pressure on the incoming powerful weirds, making the attacks of several powerful weirds that came one after another more vigorous.

Wu Qing used the power of the domain to protect the nine-star Protoss transport spacecraft to continue flying, and directed the powerful attack power of the powerful to the gathering power of each weird.

The weird in this weird interlayer world, how intelligent it is seems to be innate, and it does not depend on the strength. The IQ of several powerful weirds chasing Wu Qing seems to be very weak, and they don’t realize that Wu Qing is playing tricks on them.

The attacks of several powerful weirds are very hard.

Those weirds who really have a certain IQ and are very strong have not yet made a move.

The attacks of the powerful people in this world are more powerful and effective than any army's attacks. Every attack of the powerful weird can make millions of weirds disappear and can hurt this sandwich world which is much more fragile than the real world.

All the weirds died because of Wu Qing, so the system simply converted all the dead weirds into system resources.

The little bit of external mysterious power contained in the origin of the weird was also absorbed and transformed by the powerful system.

No matter what the mysterious external power is, it cannot escape the fate of being converted into system resources by the system.

Now, every time a weird is eliminated, the external mysterious power in this world will be weakened.

Wu Qing even felt the will of the rules of the real world and cheered involuntarily.

"Boom boom..."

"Boom boom...!"

The constant attacks of the powerful level seemed to break the space barrier between the weird interlayer world and the real world. The various space cracks in the sky could no longer be healed.

The will of the rules of the real world has been trying to extend its tentacles.

The powerful weird hidden in the weird interlayer world finally couldn't stand it anymore and commanded a large number of powerful weird to attack, trying to eliminate Wu Qing together.

The powerful weird in the dark didn't attack themselves because there was always a sense of crisis of death, which enveloped them and made them tremble with fear.

With Wu Qing's cultivation qualifications in this world, his current strength, the quality and strength of his spiritual power have reached the level of eleven stars, which can easily support him to build a powerful domain in this world.

The rules of this world are incomplete, and many creatures with eleven-star strength may not know what the domain is.

Those foreign evil gods should be able to exert strong combat power, but they are rejected by the rules of the world and cannot appear in this world.

So, Wu Qing really doesn't have many opponents in this world.

A domain guarded by Wu Qing's absolute control, no force can hurt him.

He only needs to use a little force to beat all the powerful weirdos.

Under Wu Qing's intentional guidance, the sky of this weird mezzanine world was broken down, and countless violent space energies raged, making those powerful weirdos feel frightened.

Wu Qing felt that the rules and will of the real world were almost coming.

"Queen of Insects, let's help it together!"

Wu Qing said to the Queen of Insects, and then they exerted their strength together. A force of heaven and earth containing the terrible spiritual power of Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects hit the sky directly.

It seemed that something was broken, and an indescribable will suddenly descended into this world!
